query: In what year was BRAC University established, and who founded it?
expected_output: BRAC University was established in 2001 and founded by Sir Fazle Hasan Abed.

query: Who is the current Vice-Chancellor of BRAC University?
expected_output: The Vice-Chancellor of BRAC University is Syed Ferhat Anwar.

query: Who serves as the Chancellor of BRAC University?
expected_output: The President of Bangladesh, Mohammed Shahabuddin, serves as the Chancellor of BRAC University.

query: How many schools and departments does BRAC University currently have?
expected_output: BRAC University currently has 10 schools and 8 departments.

query: How many institutes and centres are hosted at BRAC University?
expected_output: BRAC University hosts 3 institutes and 4 centres.

query: What programs does BRAC Business School (BBS) offer?
expected_output: BRAC Business School offers an undergraduate Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) program, and two graduate programs: a Master of Business Administration (MBA) and an Executive Master of Business Administration (EMBA).

query: When was the Department of Mathematics and Physical Sciences (MPS) formed, and what is its origin?
expected_output: The Department of Mathematics and Physical Sciences started on January 1, 2026, evolving from the Department of Mathematics and Natural Sciences, which was established in 2001 alongside the university.

query: When was the BRAC James P Grant School of Public Health founded and why?
expected_output: It was founded in 2004 in Dhaka to address unmet public health challenges specific to Asia, Africa, and South America.

query: What GPA is required for O-Level and A-Level applicants to undergraduate programs?
expected_output: A minimum GPA of 2.5 is required in both O-Level and A-Level, counting the best 5 O-Level subjects and best 2 A-Level subjects, graded on BRAC University's own scale (A=5, B=4, C=3, D=2), with E grades not counted.

query: Are GED qualifications accepted for undergraduate admission?
expected_output: No, applicants with only Foundation or GED qualifications are not eligible for admission to undergraduate programs.

query: How long a break in studies is acceptable for undergraduate admission applicants?
expected_output: Candidates with a break in studies of up to three years are accepted; exceptional cases beyond three years require emailing for review and approval by the Chair of the Admissions Committee.

query: Do international applicants have an application deadline?
expected_output: No, BRAC University offers three semesters per year (Spring, Summer, and Fall), and international students can apply at any time during the year with no application deadline.

query: What courses might a freshman have to take based on admission test results?
expected_output: Depending on admission test results, a freshman may be required to take one or more of: ENG 101, ENG 102 (credit courses), or ENG 091, MAT 091, MAT 092 (non-credit courses).

query: When do students attend the mandatory Residential Semester, and how much does it cost?
expected_output: All students attend the Residential Semester at the Savar campus in their 2nd semester, except Architecture students who attend in their 3rd semester. It costs Tk. 50,000 for the 4-month program, subject to increase with prior notice.

query: What percentage tuition waiver do domestic freshmen receive based on their prior academic results?
expected_output: A 25% tuition fee waiver is awarded to students admitted to undergraduate programs in their first semester, based on their performance in SSC/O-Level, HSC/A-Level, or International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma results.

query: What CGPA and credit completion are required to be eligible for the Merit Scholarship?
expected_output: Students must complete at least 30 credits and maintain a CGPA of 3.7 to be eligible for the Merit Scholarship, which can range from 10% up to 100% based on academic performance.

query: What does the BRAC Scholarship (need-based) cover for international students?
expected_output: The BRAC Scholarship offers a 100% waiver on tuition and other fees (semester fees, lab fees, library, etc.) plus food and accommodation, for economically disadvantaged but meritorious students, requiring a minimum CGPA of 3.00 to be maintained in all semesters.

query: What three offices make up BRAC University's Office of Student Affairs (OSA)?
expected_output: The Office of Student Affairs comprises the Office of Academic Advising (OAA), the Office of Co-curricular Activities (OCA), and the Office of Career Services and Alumni Relations (OCSAR).

query: What is the Professional Skills Development Program (PSDP)?
expected_output: PSDP is an intensive course for final-year students designed around the soft skills employers value most and changing workplace practices, helping prepare students for the world of work.

query: What are OCSAR's office hours?
expected_output: OCSAR's office hours are 9:00 am to 5:00 pm, Sunday through Thursday, except holidays.
